strongest_angle: Examining the breakdown of the eighth Moscow Format consultations and the subsequent cross-border fighting along Paktia province and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

key_facts.fact: Zamir Kabulov stated on October 5, 2026, that the eighth Moscow Format meeting ended without a joint statement due to disagreements between the Taliban and Pakistan.
Since October 5, 2026, reported fighting has consisted of border clashes along Afghanistan's southeastern Paktia province and Pakistan's northwestern Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province.
The 203 Mansouri Corps reported that armed clashes broke out between its forces and Pakistani troops near the Durand Line in Dand Patan district of Paktia province.
